document_metadata.title: Phase 3A Feature Engineering Discovery & Design for Process Anomaly Detection

features.physical_meaning: Ambient atmospheric air temperature at solar array
Local wind speed across PV panels governing convective cooling
Diffuse sky radiation scattering onto tilted array
Photovoltaic cell silicon wafer surface temperature
Inverter electrical AC active power output injected to AC bus
Solar panel DC power delivered to inverter input
Inverter DC-side contactor control switch command
Active electrical generator output power of the turbine
Barometric atmospheric air pressure determining air density rho
Primary nacelle ultrasonic anemometer A reading
Secondary nacelle mechanical cup anemometer B reading
Nacelle generator housing internal temperature sensor A
Nacelle gearbox housing external temperature sensor B

dataset_characteristics.temporal_ordering: Strictly monotonic increasing, zero temporal shuffling
dataset_characteristics.missing_value_behavior: Zero nulls across all 11,991 rows in all 14 channels
dataset_characteristics.preexisting_derived_features: None; existing pipeline processes strictly raw physical sensor columns

candidate_engineered_features.physical_interpretation: Instantaneous rate of change of solar AC generation; isolates sudden inverter tripping or power step spoofing
Instantaneous wind turbine active power change; captures mechanical disconnect or power setpoint clamping
Nacelle aerodynamic acceleration/deceleration proxy; flags sharp anemometer register injections
Short-term aerodynamic turbulence dispersion over ~7.9s; detects telemetry freeze (std drops to 0) or erratic noise injection
Short-term solar generation variance over ~7.9s; separates steady-state clearsky solar from oscillating cyber injections
High-pass filtered local deviation from recent 8s mean; isolates sustained attack bias shifts from slow atmospheric trends
candidate_engineered_features.causality_status: Strictly Causal (uses t and rolling [t-14, t])

candidate_engineered_features.physical_interpretation: Inverter electrical conversion loss (P_dc - P_ac). Under First Law of Thermodynamics, loss must remain strictly positive (~2-3% of power). Any single-channel Modbus spoofing on AC or DC power immediately shatters this physical invariant.
candidate_engineered_features.causality_status: Strictly Causal (point-in-time cross-channel difference at timestamp t)

candidate_engineered_features.physical_interpretation: Dual nacelle anemometer redundancy residual. Both sensors observe the identical atmospheric wind field. In baseline, mean offset is 2.65 m/s with tiny standard deviation (0.35 m/s). An attack spoofing one anemometer creates a massive multi-sigma residual.
candidate_engineered_features.causality_status: Strictly Causal (point-in-time difference at timestamp t)

candidate_engineered_features.physical_interpretation: Dual nacelle temperature symmetry residual. Temperature sensors A and B share thermal equilibrium inside the nacelle casing. Mean delta is -0.05°C (std 0.36°C). Spoofing either temperature channel causes immediate residual breakdown.
candidate_engineered_features.causality_status: Strictly Causal (point-in-time difference at timestamp t)

candidate_engineered_features.physical_interpretation: Solar panel cell thermal rise above ambient air temperature. Driven by absorbed solar photon flux; cell temperature must exceed air temperature when irradiance is positive.
candidate_engineered_features.causality_status: Strictly Causal (point-in-time difference at timestamp t)

rejected_features.feature_candidate: Multiple Rolling Means (rolling_mean(x, W) for W in [5, 15, 30, 60])
rejected_features.rejection_reason: Extreme collinearity with raw features (r = 0.9987 for W=5, r = 0.9957 for W=15). Duplicates raw input channels almost perfectly without providing orthogonal anomaly information, causing feature explosion.

Redundant and noise-prone. Because telemetry sampling interval is nearly perfectly uniform (mean 0.5262s, jitter std 3.3 ms), Δx / Δt is identical to Δx * 1.9004. Dividing by timestamp deltas injects 3 ms jitter noise without adding physical signal.

rejected_features.feature_candidate: Nonlinear Physical Ratios (e.g., P_ac / P_dc, P_ac / G_poa, P_wind / v^3)
rejected_features.rejection_reason: Numerical instability due to zero and near-zero denominators during nighttime, zero-wind, or transition regimes. Even with epsilon padding, ratios produce severe non-linear gradient spikes. Linear conservation residuals (P_dc - P_ac) capture the exact same invariant with 100% stability.

rejected_features.feature_candidate: Rolling z-scores with Local Variances ((x - μ) / σ)
rejected_features.rejection_reason: When signals are steady or zero (e.g. night-time solar irradiance or steady barometric pressure), local rolling standard deviation approaches zero (σ → 0), causing artificial catastrophic division-by-zero spikes on clean normal data.
pv_c_on_off is an intermittent boolean pulse active for only 2.3% of baseline. Discrete {-1, 0, 1} impulse differences are inappropriate for continuous recurrent neural representations.

rejected_features.feature_candidate: Differences on Quantized Slow Drift Signals (diff_pv_m_temp_air, diff_wind_m_pressure)
rejected_features.rejection_reason: Sensors have large physical time constants and 0.1-unit digital quantization. First differences at 0.5s are 99% zeros with occasional step quantization noise.

rejected_features.feature_candidate: Centered or Forward Rolling Windows ([t-k, t+k] or [t, t+k])
rejected_features.rejection_reason: Violates fundamental anti-leakage and operational causality constraints. Using future information causes lookahead contamination and is completely unexecutable in real-time streaming detection.

rejected_features.feature_candidate: Battery and Grid Demand Signals (batt_*, grid_*)
rejected_features.rejection_reason: Strictly quarantined per project scope enforcement. Silent addition of battery or demand channels is strictly prohibited.

config_a_baseline.name: CONFIG A (Authoritative Baseline)
config_a_baseline.description: Existing 14 raw physical Solar/PV and Wind telemetry channels from Phase 2B. Retained completely unchanged as the primary comparative anchor.
config_a_baseline.justification: Required benchmark anchor for rigorous experimental ablation.

config_b_temporal_dynamics.name: CONFIG B (Raw + Temporal Dynamics)
config_b_temporal_dynamics.description: 14 raw baseline features + 3 first-order temporal differences + 2 rolling volatility features.
config_b_temporal_dynamics.justification: Tests whether explicit temporal derivative and short-term volatility representations enable the LSTM to capture step tampering and sensor freeze attacks without cross-sensor coupling.

config_c_physical_invariants.name: CONFIG C (Raw + Physical Invariants)
config_c_physical_invariants.description: 14 raw baseline features + 4 linear cross-feature physical & cross-sensor redundancy residuals.
config_c_physical_invariants.justification: Directly forces the model to monitor physical conservation laws (inverter loss, cell heating) and cross-sensor parity (dual anemometers, dual nacelle temps). Isolates the specific contribution of physical consistency.

config_d_recommended_hybrid.name: CONFIG D (Recommended Parsimonious Hybrid)
config_d_recommended_hybrid.description: 14 raw baseline features + 4 physical invariant residuals + 3 first-order temporal differences + 1 temporal persistence feature.
config_d_recommended_hybrid.justification: Provides a compact, highly expressive 22-channel representation uniting physical conservation, sensor redundancy, temporal acceleration, and local deviation, while strictly avoiding feature explosion (+8 features over baseline).

future_preprocessing_strategy.chronological_split: 80% train (9,592 rows), 20% val (2,399 rows) strictly chronological
future_preprocessing_strategy.fitting_constraint: Fitted STRICTLY on training partition of clean normal baseline (run 20260225_normal). Zero attack data seen.
derived_feature_execution_order: 1. Extract raw 14 features from ASOF-aligned telemetry.
2. Compute first differences (Δx) causally with fillna(0.0).
3. Compute rolling statistics causally with min_periods=1.
4. Compute cross-feature residuals at each point in time t.
5. Concatenate raw + engineered features into unscaled matrix.
6. Fit scaler strictly on training rows; apply .transform() to validation and attack evaluation sets.
7. Generate boundary-isolated sliding sequences with sequence length L=60, stride s=1.

expected_risks_and_mitigations.description: First-order temporal differences (Δx) amplify sensor quantization noise.
expected_risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Confine differences strictly to high-SNR active electrical/kinematic signals (power, wind speed) and reject differences on slow, quantized temperature or pressure signals.

expected_risks_and_mitigations.description: Generating multiple rolling windows and overlapping statistics bloats latent representations.
expected_risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Strict feature count cap (22 features max). Explicitly reject rolling means which have r > 0.99 with raw signals.

expected_risks_and_mitigations.description: Rolling windows and differences have warm-up periods at sequence starts.
expected_risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Use min_periods=1 and fillna(0.0) so array length is strictly preserved without NaN propagation.
